chosenApproach: Preserve live EAS account:usage fetch, exact owner, exact Free plan, and fail-closed rejection of any explicitly nonzero or malformed estimated amount; tolerate absent optional usage estimates under Expo's Free no-overage guarantee. Retain original stage Android signed binary/runtime/channel/manifest and unchanged production release checks; no purchase, plan change, dependency change, native build or OTA trigger in this PR.

Keep requiring EAS CLI optional estimates, repeatedly failing the verified Free plan without publication (rejected: schema mismatch with guaranteed Free no-overage).
Add a paid plan or paid EAS build (rejected: user has no release budget).
Skip actual staging and run production OTA without served-channel verification (rejected: breaks release sequencing and safety).

EAS quota exhaustion remains provider-enforced; do not upgrade plans or buy credits.
Staging channel is staging-user, exact runtime 1.3.2, exact staging package org.mzbministry.buklod.staging, production channel and reward core unchanged.
Season2 is preview-only; production Season1 and existing rewards remain unchanged.
Secret usage JSON remains private and is deleted after checking.

Governance source gate and Main-side QA pass; no change to EAS staging publish workflow or release marker before separate trigger.
No new paid build, account upgrade or paid EAS action; ensure actual signed staging build, served channel manifest, release Update ID, runtime and unchanged production are verified after release.
